text: Onon gomɗimɓe ɓen, wata on yewtir Alyahuuda e Annasaara wennjirgol ɓe, si wanaa noone ɓurɗo moƴƴude on; on woni noddirgol ɓe waaju e hujjaaji ɓannguɗi, si wanaa hara ko ɓen tooñirɓe e maɓɓe sattere-noppi e mawnitaare, ɓe ɓannginani on hare. Ɓen ɗon, haɓee ɓe haa ɓe silma maa ɓe jonnira sagalle ɗen junngu e junngo hara ko ɓe jaasuɓe. Wi'anon Alyahuuda e Annasaara: Men gomɗinii nden Alqur'aanaare nde Alla jippini e amen, e ɗen ɗe O jippini e mooɗon immorde e Tawreeta e Linjiila. Reweteeɗo amen On e rewteeɗo mon On ko gooto Mo alaa kafidiiɗo e Reweede Mun e Jeygol Mun e timmal Mun. Menen on, ko Kanko tun men jebbilantoo.
